# Closure Report Quality Rubric
**AI-generated by:** Alson (A.I Agent)

Use this rubric after checking the acceptance criteria. A critical acceptance-criteria failure blocks the gate regardless of the rubric score.

## Score Scale

| Score | Meaning |
|---:|---|
| 1 | Unusable or missing |
| 2 | Major gaps |
| 3 | Basic but weak |
| 5 | Acceptable |
| 8 | Strong |
| 13 | Excellent and decision-ready |

## Dimensions

| # | Dimension | What to check |
|---:|---|---|
| 1 | Closure completeness | Project name, closure scope, date, reason, and closure result are supported |
| 2 | Final status summary | Scope, schedule, cost, and quality are clear and evidence-based |
| 3 | Deliverable acceptance | Deliverables, acceptance status, and evidence are recorded |
| 4 | Outstanding items | Open items have owners, actions, dates, and handoff status |
| 5 | Handover status | Receiving owner, destination, and transition state are clear |
| 6 | Lessons quality | Lessons are specific, actionable, and useful for future work |
| 7 | Administrative closure | Administrative, financial, contractual, and approval records are complete or justified |
| 8 | Conciseness and traceability | The report leads with the answer, avoids filler, and points to evidence |

## Calculation

```text
Quality % = (total awarded points / total possible points) x 100
total possible points = 8 dimensions x 13 = 104
passing threshold = 95%
```

Do not round a score up. Record each dimension score and the calculation in the Measure output.
